label: Tell me about yourself
description: A short answer to "tell me about yourself" for this job, from your history only, with a short practice script.
subject: job
brief_template: This pitch helps {name} answer "tell me about yourself" for the {role} role at {company}.
rules: Write in the first person, as the candidate would say it.
Present, past, future: what I do now, what I have done that fits this job, why this job next.
Every claim about the candidate cites me/history or settings/profile.json.
Use only what my files show. Never claim people management, a title, a scope or a skill level my history doesn't show, or anything on a do-not-claim or cautions list in my files.
Also write pitch.md: the same pitch as plain paragraphs to practise without the video.
